checks.notes: Repository unit, integration, frontend build, and policy suites.
Two clean builds have identical modeled payload inventory and release identity; platform container differences are explained.
Receipt, checksum, source inventory, native notices, and installed font/license notices inspected in the actual installer.
Windows 11 25H2; downloaded unsigned installer behavior recorded.
macOS 14 or newer; downloaded unsigned installer behavior recorded.
Ubuntu 24.04 baseline; AppImage and archive surfaces tested separately.
Ubuntu 24.04 baseline and actual Asahi show system.
Imported user-owned media remains playable after network-disabled restart without AI packs.
Import, two-pass separation, Heart transcription, edit, save, queue, and playback using the fixed private corpus.
20-song corpus; WER regression <=2 percentage points, p95 word-start regression <=100 ms, and every new whole-section omission reviewed.
Both passes complete; stems readable and aligned; truncation, silence, and audible comparison recorded.
Preparation duration and peak RAM/VRAM recorded; minimum is measured peak plus 25% and verified on representative hardware.
Cancellation and process interruption leave a usable show, recoverable job, and no partial output marked complete.
Interrupted download and failed activation preserve the prior working runtime/model and support a retry.
Controlled insufficient-memory failure does not publish partial outputs or break prepared playback.
Authenticated update, interruption boundaries, rollback pair, database recovery, anti-replay, and offline restart.
Real outer image is bound to active mount; anchor create/rotate/standalone recovery fail closed on substitution.
Normal uninstall result and retained application-data contents recorded; explicit removal tested separately.
1080p, physical audio and projector, host minimize/workspace switch, reconnect, output selection/disconnect, no app-caused dropout/freeze.
A user can collect useful redacted diagnostics without exposing library media, lyrics, secrets, or tokens.
